# API Scopes

The scopes an API key or OIDC client needs for the operator to manage each resource on an
[external instance](../guides/pocketidinstance.md#api-scopes).

| Resource | Scopes |
| --- | --- |
| [PocketIDAPI](pocketidapi.md) | `apis:read`, `apis:write` |
| [PocketIDInstance](pocketidinstance.md) | `apis:read`, `apis:write` |
| [PocketIDOIDCClient](pocketidoidcclient.md) | `apis:read`, `apis:write`, `groups:read`, `oidc-clients:read`, `oidc-clients:write` |
| [PocketIDUser](pocketiduser.md) | `users:login-codes`, `users:read`, `users:write` |
| [PocketIDUserGroup](pocketidusergroup.md) | `groups:read`, `groups:write`, `users:read` |
| All | `apis:read`, `apis:write`, `groups:read`, `groups:write`, `oidc-clients:read`, `oidc-clients:write`, `users:login-codes`, `users:read`, `users:write` |
